# plakar_environment (Resource)

An organization environment, one name in the list the Classification page shows. New organizations come with integration, production, staging and testing; those can be deleted like any other, so to manage one, import it first: creating a name that already exists is an error, because the server would answer as if it had created it and a later destroy would delete a value Terraform never made. Names are kept exactly as written, case and spaces included, so Prod and prod are two environments. There is no update: changing the name replaces. Destroying the resource removes the name for the whole organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A name of your own, next to the defaults every organization starts with.
resource "plakar_environment" "preprod" {
  name = "preprod"
}

# A default is managed only once imported: creating it would be refused. Once
# managed, destroying the resource deletes it from the organization.
import {
  to = plakar_environment.production
  id = "production"
}

resource "plakar_environment" "production" {
  name = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the environment. Changing it replaces.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Id of the organization. Defaults to the provider's organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The environment name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <name>, in the provider's organization
terraform import plakar_environment.production production
```
